board: ASAIR AHT25 temperature & humidity sensor (Aosong, 4-pin 2.54 mm plug-in: VDD, SDA, GND, SCL)
reason: The part check passed on the first run on both ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring with 4.7 kΩ SDA/SCL pull-ups, design checks, breadboard, simulator test (T=-12.5C H=72%), clean circuit-board DRC, footprint and LCSC C3012623. The sim encodes the datasheet's 20-bit RH/T formulas and CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). The driver follows the AHT25 reading process in section 7.4, including the 0x18 status check and the 0xAC 0x33 0x00 trigger.
breakoutPinoutSource: Aosong AHT25 datasheet V1.0, section 5 Table 5 pin distribution, top view (1 VDD, 2 SDA, 3 GND, 4 SCL)
